name.description: A readable name for the service, used in server messages.

logfile.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' for stdout. Empty string disables logging.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the procServ daemon. Empty string disables PID file creation.

foreground.description: Keep the server process in the foreground.

chdir.description: Directory to change to before starting the child process.

ignore_chars.description: Characters to ignore on control connections (e.g., ^D^C).

holdoff.description: Minimum seconds between child restart attempts.

noautorestart.description: Disable automatic restart of the child process on exit.

wait.description: Wait for a control connection to issue a manual start command.

oneshot.description: Exit the server when the child process exits.

restrict.description: Restrict TCP access for control and log endpoints to localhost.

logport.description: Endpoint for read-only log access (e.g., '20001' or 'unix:/var/run/procServ/log').

info_file.description: Path to a file where server PID and endpoint info are written.

corysize.description: Maximum size of core file for the child process. 0 disables core dumps.

killsig.description: Signal number sent to kill the child process (e.g., 9 for SIGKILL).

endpoints.description: List of endpoints for control access (e.g., port numbers or unix socket paths). Each item is a string.

command.description: The command executable to run as the child process.

command_args.description: Arguments to pass to the child command.
